verdict.rationale: GitCafe documents personal access tokens that let tools use the REST API or Git over HTTPS "with only the permissions you grant" and that always expire. Its MCP connections can be limited to "Only select repositories", which gives agents least-privilege, scoped access. Missing for 10: a documented list of granular permission scopes, a separate agent/bot identity (tokens act "as you"), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
